examples.text: anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ, yo vatthaṃ paridahissati, apeto damasaccena, na so kāsāvam'arahati.
yo ca jānaṃ saṃyat'atto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam'arahati, sa munī monam'ajjhagā'ti.

8901.meaning1: is worthy (to); is fit (to); is capable (of)

examples.text: tatra idaṃ nissāya idaṃ pajahatha, tayo satipaṭṭhānā yadariyo sevati yadariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam'anusāsitum'arahati, so vuccati yogg'ācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathī'ti, ayam'uddeso saḷāyatanavibhaṅgassa.
nikkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito.

8902.meaning1: should; ought (to); is suitable (for); it is befitting (for)
8902.commentary: (MNa) vattituñ'ca arahatī'ti vattati c'eva vattituñ'ca arahati. vattituṃ yutto'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: na arahati bhavaṃ kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. samaṇo tv'eva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
evaṃvādiṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthāraṃ arahati sāvako upasaṅkamituṃ dhammassavanāya. tassa satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.

8904.meaning2: state of an arahant, final emancipation, highest stage of the Path, sainthood

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa arahattappattassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkameyyaṃ, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike aññaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

sace hi ayaṃ paṭhamavaye bhoge akhepetvā kamm'ante payojayissa, imasmiṃ'y'eva nagare aggaseṭṭhi abhavissa. sace pana nikkhamitvā pabbajissa, arahattaṃ pāpuṇissa, bhariyā'pi'ssa anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhahissa.

8905.meaning1: contact with the understanding of the awakened state

8906.meaning1: for arahantship; to attain the awakened state

8907.meaning1: pinnacle of the awakened state; culmination in enlightenment
8907.commentary: (DNt) kūṭo viya kūṭ'āgārassa bhagavato desanāya arahattaṃ uttam'aṅgabhūtan'ti āha arahattanikūṭenā'ti.

examples.text: kulaputto taṃ sutvā arūp'āvacarajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādiyi, bhagavā tassa rūp'āvacar'ārūp'āvacaresu nikantiyā pariyādinnabhāvaṃ ñatvā arahattanikūṭaṃ gaṇhanto so n'eva taṃ abhisaṅkharotī'ti-ādim'āha.

8908.meaningLit: discourse on the question about arahantship

8909.meaningLit: reached the state of being worthy

examples.text: tassa yo pubbe chando ahosi arahattappattiyā, arahattappatte yo tajjo chando so paṭippassaddho. yaṃ pubbe vīriyaṃ ahosi arahattappattiyā, arahattappatte yaṃ tajjaṃ vīriyaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ.
atha kho āyasmato soṇassa arahattappattassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkameyyaṃ, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike aññaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

8910.meaning1: attainment of the awakened state; reaching the state of awakened state

examples.text: tassa yo pubbe chando ahosi arahattappattiyā, arahattappatte yo tajjo chando so paṭippassaddho. yaṃ pubbe vīriyaṃ ahosi arahattappattiyā, arahattappatte yaṃ tajjaṃ vīriyaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ.
yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṃ byākaroti, sabbo so catūhi maggehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.

8911.meaning1: fruit of the awakened state; fruition of awakening

examples.text: cattāri sāmaññaphalāni, sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ.
tathāgatasāvake arahante dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ tatiyā pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā. arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ catutthī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā

8912.meaning1: personal experience of the fruit of the awakened state; intimate experience of the fruition of enlightenment

examples.text: aṭṭha puggalā dakkhiṇeyyā, sot'āpanno, sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā, arahattaphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno.

8914.meaning1: perception related to the fruition of the awakened state

8915.meaning1: meditative composure belonging to the fruition of the awakened state

8916.meaning1: attainment of the fruit of the awakened state

8917.meaningLit: discourse on the fruit of arahantship

8918.meaning1: liberation which is the fruit of the awakened state; release, the result of arahantship
8918.commentary: (DNt) akuppā cetovimuttī'ti arahattaphalavimutti akuppabhāvena ukkaṃsagatattā. aññathā sabbā'pi phalasamāpattiyo akuppā eva paṭipakkhehi akopanīyattā. (MNt) sabbasaṃkilesehi paṭippassaddhivasena cetaso vimuttī'ti cetovimutti. ten'āha arahattaphalavimuttī'ti.

examples.text: akuppā cetovimuttī'ti arahattaphalavimutti. ayam'attho etassā'ti etadatthaṃ, arahattaphal'attham'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ.

8920.meaning1: path of arahantship; path to the fully awakened state
8920.commentary: (PMa) kilesehi ārakattā, kilesārīnaṃ hatattā, saṃsāracakkassa arānaṃ hatattā, pāpakaraṇe rahābhāvā, paccay'ādīnaṃ arahattā arahaṃ, arahato bhāvo arahattaṃ. kiṃ taṃ? arahattaphalaṃ. arahattassa maggo arahattamaggo.

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, ye kho keci loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ye te, bhante, loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā ete tesaṃ aññatarā'ti.

8921.meaning1: due to the path and fruition of the awakened state

8922.meaning1: what is called the awakened state

8926.meaningLit: attained the state of being worthy

examples.text: upakaṭṭhāya pavāraṇāya sabb'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu

8928.meaning1: awakened being; fourth stage of the path
8928.meaning2: who has attained the Summum Bonum
8928.commentary: (MNa) tehi ārakattā arahaṃ hoti, dūrībhūtattā'ti attho. (SNa) ārakā kilesehī'ti arahanto.
8928.notes: the commentaries supply a multitude of folk etymologies, such as ara + haṃ = enemy + killer, a+ rahaṃ = no + secrecy, etc.

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve arahanto sammāsambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ
aññataro ca kho pan'āyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī'ti.

8929.meaning1: killer of an Arahant; murderer of an awakened being
8929.commentary: (KVa) yena antamaso gihiliṅge ṭhito'pi manussajātiko khīṇ'āsavo sañcicca jīvitā voropito, ayaṃ arahantaghātako nāma.

examples.text: arahanto ete, bhikkhave, bhikkhū. arahantaghātako, bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti.

8930.meaning1: we are arahants; we are awakened beings

examples.text: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

8938.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Brāhmaṇasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

8939.meaning2: Chapter 7 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

8942.meaning1: concerning awakened beings; regarding the enlightened
8942.commentary: (DNa) buddh'ūpasañhitā'ti buddhaṃ ārabbha buddhaṃ nissayaṃ katvā pavattā'ti attho. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesi, imā ca gāthā abhāsi buddh'ūpasañhitā dhamm'ūpasañhitā saṅgh'ūpasañhitā arahant'ūpasañhitā kām'ūpasañhitā

8943.grammar: masc, nom sg of arahant, irreg
8943.meaning1: awakened being; fourth stage of the path

examples.text: bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samaṇo iti'pi brāhmaṇo iti'pi nahātako iti'pi vedagū iti'pi sottiyo iti'pi ariyo iti'pi arahaṃ iti'pi

8944.grammar: masc, nom sg of arahant, irreg
8944.meaning1: awakened being; fourth stage of the path

examples.text: antagū'si pāragū dukkhassa, arahā'si sammāsambuddho khīṇ'āsavaṃ taṃ maññe. jutimā mutimā pahūtapañño, dukkhass'antakaraṃ atāresi maṃ.
n'eva kho tvaṃ, bāhiya, arahā, n'āpi arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno. sā'pi te paṭipadā n'atthi yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assa arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno'ti.

8946.meaning1: not looking for privacy; not seeking solitude
8946.commentary: (VINa) araho'pekkhā aññavihitā'ti na rahoassād'āpekkhā rahoassādato aññavihitāva hutvā ñātiṃ vā pucchati, dāne vā pūjāya vā manteti.

examples.text: anāpatti yo koci viññū dutiyo hoti, tiṭṭhati na nisīdati, araho'pekkho, aññavihito nisīdati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

8947.meaning1: perceiving as not in private; regarding as not alone

examples.text: sāmaṃ, adhiṭṭhāya, dūtena, dūtaparaṃparāya, visakkiyena dūtena, gatapaccāgatena dūtena, araho rahosaññī, raho arahosaññī, araho arahosaññī, raho rahosaññī

8948.meaning1: without desire; with no passion; without lust (for)

examples.text: tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, chandaṃ janessati vāyamissati vīriyaṃ ārabhissati tass'aṅgaṇassa pahānāya, so arāgo adoso amoho anaṅgaṇo asaṃkiliṭṭhacitto kālaṃ karissati.

8949.meaning1: without a king; having no ruler
8949.meaning2: without a king; having no ruler
8949.construction:
na > a + √rāj + a + ka
arāja + ka
8949.commentary: (ANa) so'pi na arājakan'ti so'pi aññaṃ nissayarājānaṃ alabhitvā cakkaṃ nāma vattetuṃ na sakkotī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo'pi so, bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā so'pi na arājakaṃ cakkaṃ vattetī'ti. evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko pana, bhante, rañño cakkavattissa dhammikassa dhammarañño rājā'ti ?

8950.meaning2: without a king; having no ruler

8951.synonym: appiya, amitta, diṭṭha, disa, viddesī, sapatta
8951.commentary: (JAa) khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito'ti yasmiṃ udakapiṭṭhe khemabhāvo nibbhayabhāvo, tasmiṃ attapaccatthiko sapatto uṭṭhito.

examples.text: khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito, dakassa majjhe jalate ghat'āsano, na ajja vāso mahiyā mahīruhe, disā bhajavho saraṇ'ājja no bhayan'ti.
tena kho pana samayena ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti

8954.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.
anāpatti amajjañ'ca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasaṃ taṃ pivati, sūpasampāke, maṃsasampāke, telasampāke, āmalakaphāṇite, amajjaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ pivati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

8959.meaning2: kind of thorny tree with fruits

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma mahāariṭṭhako maṇi, evam'assa sīsaṃ hoti. seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ rūpiyaṃ, evam'assa dantā honti.

8963.grammar: masc pl, from na riṭṭha, neg
8963.meaning1: name of a group of deities
8963.commentary: (DNa) ariṭṭhakā ca rojā cā'ti ariṭṭhakadevā ca rojadevā ca.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā, jalam'aggisikhā'r'iva, ariṭṭhakā ca rojā ca, umāpupphanibhāsino.

8966.meaning1: not free (from); not rid (of); not devoid (of)
8966.commentary: (SNa) evaṃ kho, gahapati, kāmehi aritto hotī'ti evaṃ kilesakāmehi aritto hoti anto kāmānaṃ bhāvena atuccho. (ANa) arittajjhāno'ti atucchajjhāno apariccattajjhāno vā.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, kāmehi aritto hoti? idha, gahapati, ekacco kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.

accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṃ [mettaṃ cittaṃ, mettacittaṃ] āsevati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro, amoghaṃ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati. ko pana vādo ye naṃ bahulīkarontī'ti!

vāsīhi tacchetvā nikhādanaṃ ādāya anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā lekhaṇiyā likheyya, lekhaṇiyā likhitvā pāsāṇaguḷena dhoveyya, pāsāṇaguḷena dhovetvā nāvaṃ kareyya, nāvaṃ katvā phiy'ārittaṃ bandheyya, phiya-arittaṃ bandhitvā nadiṃ patāreyya.

8969.meaning1: not devoid of meditation attainment; not lacking in meditation
8969.commentary: (ANa) arittajjhāno'ti atucchajjhāno apariccattajjhāno vā. (ANt) arittajjhāno'ti avirahitajjhāno. atucchajjhāno'ti jhānena atuccho.

examples.text: accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṃ āsevati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro, amoghaṃ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati. ko pana vādo ye naṃ bahulīkarontī'ti!
idha mayhaṃ, āvuso, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, ariyo tuṇhībhāvo, ariyo tuṇhībhāvo'ti vuccati.
saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.

8972.meaning1: noble; distinguished; of an awakened being; of the Buddha

examples.text: saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.
pañcahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sār'ādāyinī ca hoti var'ādāyinī ca kāyassa. katamehi pañcahi?
sammādiṭṭhiṃ'p'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ vadāmi. atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi sāsavā puññabhāgiyā upadhivepakkā, atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.

8974.meaning1: ethically noble person; person of moral integrity

examples.text: vivekaññ'eva sikkhetha, etadariyānam'uttamaṃ, na tena seṭṭho maññetha, sa ve nibbānasantike.
idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati
kodhaṃ jhatvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ jhatvā na socati, kodhassa visamūlassa, madhur'aggassa devate, vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañ'hi jhatvā na socatī'ti.
kathañ'ca bhikkhu ariyo hoti? ārak'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, saṃkilesikā, ponobbhavikā, sadarā, dukkhavipākā, āyatiṃ, jātijarāmaraṇiyā.

8976.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
8976.commentary: (MNa) ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo'ti ime tayo janā.

examples.text: ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, ath'accuto accutagāmabyāmako, sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, asayho khem'ābhirato ca sorato.

katamesu aṭṭhasu? aṭṭhasu ariyaaṭṭh'aṅgikamaggesu, imesu kho, āvuso, aṭṭhasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā subhāvitacitto sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

8982.meaning1: pleasing to the noble ones; agreeable to noble beings
8982.commentary: (SNa) ariyakantehī'ti pañcahi sīlehi. tāni hi ariyānaṃ kantāni piyāni. bhav'antaragatā'pi ariyā tāni na vijahanti, tasmā ariyakantānī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.

8983.meaning1: criticizing a noble person; blaming an awakened being
8983.commentary: (SNa) yam'ariyagarahī'ti yaṃ ariye garahanto nirayaṃ upapajjati, tattha ettakaṃ āyuppamāṇan'ti.

examples.text: sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsati pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.

8984.meaning1: of noble conduct; of noble behaviour

examples.text: sace c'assa kathākāmo, kālam'aññāya paṇḍito, dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā, yā ariyacaritā kathā.

8985.meaning1: with a noble heart; with an awakened mind; (or) intent on the noble

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa ariyañāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
abbhā mutto'va candimā'ti yathā abbhā, evaṃ kilesā. yathā cando, evaṃ ariyañāṇaṃ. yathā candimā devaputto, evaṃ bhikkhu.

8987.meaning1: and the Buddha's eight-part; and the noble eight-fold

examples.text: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyañ'c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

8990.meaning2: seeing what belongs to the noble ones, what is noble

8991.meaning1: noble wealth; treasure of the noble ones

examples.text: satta ariyadhanāni, saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ.

8992.meaning1: of noble character; of noble nature

examples.text: santo ca bhikkhu abhinibbut'atto, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno, tam'ariyadhammaṃ kusalā vadanti, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke.

8993.meaning1: teaching of the Buddha; noble teaching

examples.text: ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
paroparaṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā, mā mohayī jānam'anomavīriya, vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.

8996.meaning1: hearing the teaching of the Buddha; listening to the noble teaching

examples.text: so aparena samayena ariyadhammaṃ suṇāti, yoniso manasi karoti, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjati. so ariyadhammassavanaṃ āgamma yonisomanasikāraṃ dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipattiṃ asaṃsaṭṭho viharati kāmehi asaṃsaṭṭho akusalehi dhammehi.

8998.meaning2: deportment, four postures, viz. walking, standing, sitting, and lying down

8999.commentary: (DNt) ariyā niddosā pariyesanā gavesanā'ti ariyapariyesanā, ariyehi sādhūhi pariyesitabbā'ti'pi ariyapariyesanā'ti.

examples.text: attanā saṃkilesadhammo samāno saṃkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso ariyapariyesanā'ti.
